sentences.text: Neil Percival Young , -LRB- born November 12 , 1945 -RRB- , is a Canadian singer-songwriter , musician , producer , director and screenwriter .
Young began performing in a group covering Shadows instrumentals in Canada in 1960 .	Shadows	The Shadows

In 1966 , after a brief stint with the Rick James-fronted Mynah Birds , he moved to Los Angeles , where he formed Buffalo Springfield with Stephen Stills , Richie Furay and others .	Rick James	Rick James	Buffalo Springfield	Buffalo Springfield	Mynah Birds	The Mynah Birds	Stephen Stills	Stephen Stills	Richie Furay	Richie Furay
Young had released two solo albums by the time he joined Crosby , Stills & Nash in 1969 , in addition to two as a member of Buffalo Springfield .	Buffalo Springfield	Buffalo Springfield

From his early solo albums and those with his backing band Crazy Horse , Young has recorded a steady stream of studio and live albums , sometimes warring with his recording company along the way .	Crazy Horse	Crazy Horse (band)
Young 's often distorted electric guitar work , deeply personal lyrics and signature tenor singing voice transcend his long career .	guitar	guitar	tenor	tenor
Young also plays piano and harmonica on many albums which frequently combine folk , rock , blues and other musical styles .	harmonica	harmonica	piano	piano
Known to rip up live set lists , Young often plays acoustic versions of songs in one show and electric versions in others .

His gritty guitar work , especially with Crazy Horse , earned him the nickname `` Godfather of Grunge '' and led to his 1995 album Mirror Ball with Pearl Jam .	guitar	guitar	Crazy Horse	Crazy Horse (band)	Pearl Jam	Pearl Jam	Mirror Ball	Mirror Ball (Neil Young album)
More recently Young has been backed by Promise of the Real .	Promise of the Real	Lukas Nelson & Promise of the Real

Young directed -LRB- or co-directed -RRB- films using the pseudonym Bernard Shakey , including Journey Through the Past -LRB- 1973 -RRB- , Rust Never Sleeps -LRB- 1979 -RRB- , Human Highway -LRB- 1982 -RRB- , Greendale -LRB- 2003 -RRB- , and CSNY/D éjà Vu -LRB- 2008 -RRB- .	Journey Through the Past	Journey Through the Past (film)	Rust Never Sleeps	Rust Never Sleeps	Human Highway	Human Highway	Greendale	Greendale (album)
He also contributed to the soundtracks of the films Philadelphia -LRB- 1993 -RRB- and Dead Man -LRB- 1995 -RRB- .	Philadelphia	Philadelphia (film)	Dead Man	Dead Man
Young has received several Grammy and Juno awards .	Grammy	Grammy	Juno	Juno Awards

The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inducted him twice : as a solo artist in 1995 and in 1997 as a member of Buffalo Springfield .	Rock	Rock music	Buffalo Springfield	Buffalo Springfield	Rock & Roll Hall of Fame	Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
In 2000 , Rolling Stone named Young the 34th greatest rock 'n roll artist .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone
He has lived in California since the 1960s but retains Canadian citizenship .
He was awarded the Order of Manitoba on July 14 , 2006 , and was made an Officer of the Order of Canada on December 30 , 2009 .	Order of Manitoba	Order of Manitoba	Order of Canada	Order of Canada
